name: Eco Prim PU 1K Turbo
description: Eco Prim PU 1K Turbo is the rapid grade of the Mapei one component polyurethane primer, a solvent free liquid that cures on the moisture in the screed and in the air, and its figures are its own and not the plain grade's. It sets to light foot traffic in 30 to 40 minutes and hardens in 2 hours, against 7 to 8 hours and 24 hours for Eco Prim PU 1K, and parquet may be bonded onto it from 2 hours and up to 24 hours after priming. It is used at 80 to 100 g per square metre per coat where the plain grade takes 200 to 400. It consolidates dusty cementitious and anhydrite screeds and waterproofs screeds carrying up to 6 per cent CM, or 92 per cent relative humidity in one coat and 98 per cent in two. EMICODE EC1 Plus, odourless and not flammable.
meta_description: Eco Prim PU 1K Turbo TDS: rapid polyurethane primer for damp screeds, 80 to 100 g/m2 per coat and hard in 2 hours. Data sheet from Lapiz Blue, Dubai.

specs.coverage: 80-100 g/m² per coat. As a vapour barrier up to a maximum of 450 g/m².
specs.storage_shelf_life: 12 months in its original, well sealed container under normal conditions, protected from frost
specs.maximum_residual_humidity: 6% CM (carbide hygrometer, UNI 10329), or 92% R.H. for 1 coat and 98% for 2 coats (in situ probe test, ASTM F2170 and BS 8203). On heated screeds, 3% CM or 50% R.H.
specs.waiting_time_before_laying: minimum 2 hours, maximum 24 hours, laying directly with a reactive adhesive
specs.cleaning_agent: Thinner PU or Cleaner L while fresh, Pulicol 2000 once set

applications: Surface consolidation and dust repelling treatment on cementitious, anhydrite and heated screeds
Waterproofing cementitious screeds too damp for parquet to be laid on them
Priming before parquet is bonded with Mapei resin based reactive adhesives
Priming OSB chipboard panels, slab paved surfaces, ceramic tiles and traces of old glue
Anti dust treatment for cementitious and dry anhydrite screeds with a crumbly surface
Consolidating partly detached elements when an existing parquet floor is refurbished
notes: Mapei S.p.A. edition of the sheet, revision 2914-9-2026 en (IT), hosted on the Mapei UAE site (librariesprovider59); Mapei Construction Chemicals L.L.C publishes no separate Emirates edition. An earlier pass was handed the plain EC Prim PU 1K sheet and the record was held back for it. This is the Turbo sheet, document 2914, and every figure here is read from it: the cure times are the Turbo's own and differ from the plain grade throughout. Mapei prints the product as EC Prim PU 1K Turbo on the technical sheet and on the safety data sheet, and as ECO PRIM PU 1K TURBO in the title of its own UAE catalogue page and in the file name of the sheet; the record keeps Eco Prim PU 1K Turbo, which is the name and the slug already in the manifest and matches the live Eco Prim PU 1K and Eco Prim T Plus pages. The sheet prints no EN classification for this primer, only EMICODE EC1 Plus, so the classification field is left empty rather than filled with a class Mapei does not print.
